def clipped(st):
 cx,cy,l,w,ang,c=st
 center=np.array([cx,cy])/S;vec=np.array([np.cos(ang),np.sin(ang)]);lo=-l/(2*S);hi=-lo
 for d in range(2):
  if abs(vec[d])>1e-7:
   ts=sorted([(1.5-center[d])/vec[d],(225.68-center[d])/vec[d]])
   lo=max(lo,ts[0]);hi=min(hi,ts[1])
 return center+lo*vec,center+hi*vec,w/S,int(c)

def main(stroke_path='/app/output/fit.json',prefix='trajectory'):
 s=Session('/app/instance.json',render=False);p=s.primitives();s.record_start();t0=time.time()
 def mv(xyz,speed=.18,settle=3):
  res=p['move_tip'](xyz,speed=speed,settle=settle)
